TideLM writes a typed plan; Tideway validates every call (known tool, typed arguments, real counterparty names) before anything runs.
Tools are read or propose only. There is no approve, pay or transfer tool.
Replies are composed by code from tool output, so the model cannot invent a figure.

Your first cash-flow review

Follow four steps at your own pace. This demo uses fictional records. No real money moves.

Hide quick start
1
Check your cash forecast

Start with the target date, reserve and expected collections. Projections are estimates.

Open cash weather
2
Find a rescue plan

Ask Tideway for options, then compare dates, fees and remaining risk before choosing.

Open rescue plan
3
Review before approving

Read the exact terms and use your own PIN. Larger actions need two people. Execution is a separate action after agreement.

Review the workflow
4
Check what happened

Inspect the audit trail and receipts. Read-back confirms what changed after execution.

Open evidence
